body.message: Hello. I am writing to you with full confidence that you have been patient with my delayed payment, and because you trust that I will never be late in payment unless there are compelling reasons, which is indeed the case. I ask that you take this situation into consideration, as I am currently unemployed and my country is at war. I am waiting until the end of this month for the money to arrive, and I will then pay you. Please note, I ask that you do not send anyone to knock on my door, causing disturbance and violating my privacy. Even the government here is considerate of people in these circumstances.
